author: BlueClue Dev Team
sprint: Milestone Feedback — Classifier Edge Case Improvements

achieved_metrics.note: All targets exceeded. Tested on expanded 73-case suite including 16 new edge cases.

rationale: Milestone feedback called out classification edge cases as a known limitation. Primary weaknesses were (1) priority scoring too aggressive for 'broken' keyword and (2) insufficient HIGH-priority signals for access lockouts, MFA failures, and repeated crashes. Additionally, peripheral device disconnects were misrouted to network category.

changes: Raised laptop keyword weight 3.0 → 4.0
Raised mouse keyword weight 2.5 → 4.0
Added 'server' to hardware category (weight 3.5)
Added 'wireless receiver', 'receiver' hardware peripheral keywords
Added peripheral-disconnect keywords to hardware (mouse/keyboard disconnecting)
Added 'battery is dead', 'battery dead' hardware keywords
Expanded hardware phrases: wireless receiver, battery is dead, spilled, liquid damage, server down
Expanded software phrases: printer software, printer driver, software install, software won't install
Lowered 'broken' HIGH priority weight 4.0 → 2.5
Added HIGH priority: locked out, account locked, password expired, not responding, update failed, keeps crashing, remote access not working, MFA failure keywords, deadline urgency
Reduced 'blocking' HIGH weight 4.5 → 2.5; added precise 'blocking my work' (5.0)
Reduced 'need' MEDIUM weight 2.5 → 1.0; reduced 'help' MEDIUM weight 2.0 → 0.5
Added LOW priority: slow, running slow, buffering, optimizing, optimization, performance issue
Added subject parameter to classify() with 2x subject weighting (combined_text = subject + subject + description)
Added subject_used field to classify() return dict
Added subject 2x weighting in fit(): combined_text = subject + subject + description
Added subject 2x weighting in transform(): same pattern
Expanded URGENCY_KEYWORDS critical list: locked out, account locked, password expired, MFA failures
Expanded URGENCY_KEYWORDS high list: not responding, keeps crashing, update failed, deadline-urgency patterns
Expanded URGENCY_KEYWORDS technical list: driver, firmware, registry, event log
Added ACCURACY_TARGETS block documenting February baseline, known weaknesses, and sprint targets
Added 16 new edge-case test scenarios (total: 57 → 73 test cases)
New edge case categories: subject-line weighted tests, negation/contradiction, deadline-urgency, multi-topic root-cause, peripheral damage
Updated run_test() to pass optional subject field to classifier
Raised success threshold 70% → 87%
New model card created documenting all v2 changes, baseline, targets, and known limitations
